title: New Code Geass Anime Reveals New Look & Cast Ahead of 2027 Release
content:
Code Geass is coming back next year with a brand new anime, and a new look has been revealed at the wild cast of new characters fans will see in action with this next generation of the franchise. Code Geass is now in the midst of commemorating the 20th anniversary of the TV anime’s original release , and with it is coming back with a brand new iteration of the franchise that looks much different than all of the other TV series and movie releases before it.

Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal is the next generation of the franchise coming in 2027 , but has revealed very little about what to expect from the new anime thus far. But with it preparing for some early preview screenings in Japan starting this January, Bandai Namco Filmworks has revealed a new poster for the coming series along with the reveal of the new voice cast behind it all as well. You can check out the new look at Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal below.

Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal Reveals New Look at 2027 Launch

Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal is officially scheduled for a release sometime in 2027 , but a more concrete release date or potential international streaming plans have yet to be announced as of this time. It’s set to have some preview screenings in Japan beginning next January, so there is a solid chance it’s going to hit much sooner within 2027 than fans might expect it to. As for what to expect from this next entry, it’s going to be a full TV series unlike some of the other Code Geass miniseries or feature film projects that have been released over the years.

Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal will be directed by Kazuya Nomura for Bandai Namco Filmworks and Sunrise with Mado Nozaki writing the scripts, Rolua handling the character designs, Yoshi. designing the Agarmatha (the mechs seen in the series), Junbun Lin overseeing the special effects, Ichinogi designing the new anime’s logo, Kengo Shigemura serving as editor, and Taro Iwashiro composing the music for it. It’s also been revealed the main duo for the cast are Ivan Shibata as Aspal and Hibiku Yamamura as Zoe, but more will be revealed at a later date.

What’s Next for Code Geass ?

Code Geass has been working through a special anniversary celebration for the past few years that has resulted in all sorts of new projects , but this is the first full TV anime series released in quite some time. It’s set in a distant future where Emperor Fokasu has been lording over the Roman Empire, and has been in the midst of a long string of wars. Aspal is a young slave meets the detached head a young woman, and the two of them spark a whole new journey that they embark on together.

Code Geass has long since left Lelouch behind following the first iteration of the series, and has instead been all about the titular power as later generations of its users end up using it for their own means. This is likely going to be the case for Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal , so what are you hoping to see in this new series? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: A Legendary Action Series Is Finally Getting an Anime After 14 Years – Watch First Look Trailer
content:
A legendary action manga is finally getting its own official anime adaptation 14 years after its original debut, and the first look has been revealed at what to expect ahead of its big debut. The Fall 2026 anime schedule has been filled with some strong new releases that are going to cap off a year of notable hits, but there’s still one new anime bringing up the rear and hoping to end the year on an even stronger note. And this new anime has had fans waiting 14 years for it.

Satoshi Mizukami’s Spirit Circle originally made its debut with Shonen Ganosha’s Young King OURs magazine in 2012, and had a solid four year run before it wrapped ten years ago. But now the franchise is coming back (following the successful debut of Lucifer and the Biscuit Hammer ‘s own anime a few years ago ) with a new revival anime series hitting screens later this December. Giving fans the first look at what to expect from the new series, you can check out the first trailer and poster for Spirit Circle below to see what it’s all about.

Spirit Circle Announces New Anime Revival After 14 Years

Spirit Circle will be making its debut sometime in December later this year, but has yet to confirm a concrete release date or international streaming plans as of the time of this writing. The new anime was directed by the late Tatsuo Sato (who also wrote the scripts for the series) for NAGOMI and EOTA, and produced by TWIN ENGINE. Assistant director Kentaro Mizuno took over duties following Sato’s passing with Satoru Fujimoto providing the character designs. The ending theme revealed in the trailer is titled “No Matter the World,” as performed by Anna Nagase.

The voice cast for Spirit Circle has been announced as well as along with performing for the ending theme, Anna Nagase also stars in the series as Kouko Ishigami. Kazuki Ura stars as Fuuta Okeya, Eri Yukimura as Rune, and Yuichi Nakamura as East. With the news of the adaptation, Mizukami revealed an official statement to help celebrate, “Spirit Circle is getting an anime adaptation! It’s a story that takes us through seven different lives, each set in a different time and place,” the creator’s statement begins.

What to Know for Spirit Circle ‘s Anime

“With seven times the usual amount of worldbuilding required and an unusual runtime that’s longer than one cour but shorter than two, bringing this story to anime was no easy task,” Mizukami noted about the work done on the new Spirit Circle anime. “I’d like to express my heartfelt gratitude to everyone on the production team who worked so hard to overcome these challenges and make this adaptation possible, and especially to Director Tatsuo Sato.

With the creator then capping it off with, “Whether you’ve read the original manga or are discovering Spirit Circle for the first time, I hope you’ll stay with us all the way to the end.” When Fuuta discovers that he can see spirits, he also find out he’s stuck in a cycle of reincarnation that he and a mysterious new force try to break out of it. But with the series kicking off this December, it won’t be too long before we see more of it in action. What do you think of Spirit Circle so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Dragon Quest RPG Mobile Game's Trailer Reveals 2027 Launch, Closed Beta Test in December
content:
The Dragon Quest franchise announced that Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle ( Dragon Quest RPG: Makai-Ju to Michibikareshi Shima ), a new game for iOS and Android devices, will launch in 2027. The company streamed an English announcement trailer:

The game's official website describe the story:

High above the world, on the floating isle of Monbelusha, the annual Ringing Feast is in full swing. But as the people offer prayers, calamity strikes without warning. The fiend Zaahl corrupts Yggdrasil, once a shining symbol of hope, into Grimvein, a cursed tree whose dark influence spreads despair far and wide. As Monbelusha crumbles, a boy plummets towards the world below. The Goddess Belusha entrusts him with a single, mysterious branch. He must now take up his calling as Warden of the World Tree and embark on a journey to save the world, soaring across the skies on the isle of the chosen.

The game features turn-based battles, multiple party members, dungeon exploration, and character progression. The game will include support for English, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese (Traditional) languages.

There will be a closed beta test from December 8-15. Applications are due on November 23.

The Dragon Quest Monsters: Super Light mobile game launched in January 2014. The game ended its service in January 2024, making it the longest running Dragon Quest smartphone game, for almost 10 years.

The Dragon Quest Dokodemo Monster Parade smartphone game, which launched in 2015, ended its service in July 2020. The Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai smartphone game launched in September 2021, and ended its service in April 2023.

Dragon Quest Tact , the franchise 's tactical, role-playing smartphone game launched for iOS and Android devices in Japan in July 2020, and saw a Western release in January 2021. The game ended service in the West in February 2024.

The global version of Dragon Quest of the Stars ( Hoshi no Dragon Quest ) smartphone role-playing game launched in February 2020. The game ended service in June 2021. The game had the largest world in the series' history, and its focus was on exploring the world and fighting monsters.

title: Sword Art Online Creator’s New Anime Confirms How Long It’s Going to Be
content:
The creator behind Sword Art Online has a new anime now airing its episodes through the Fall, and a new update has revealed just how long Devils’ Crest is going to be sticking around for. The Fall 2026 anime schedule has been packed with one major release after another, but the final of the new debuts made its premiere this month as Devils’ Crest is now on screens at last . With the premiere of its first two episodes, now the anime has given fans an even more crucial update.

To celebrate the debut of Devils’ Crest this past week , the official website behind the series has shared some special behind the scenes news about how the anime has come together. But it has also importantly confirmed that the new anime will be running for two consecutive cours in total. While a concrete episode count has yet to be revealed, this means it’s going to be running through the Fall 2026 and Winter 2027 anime schedule before it wraps up.

Devils’ Crest Confirmed for Two Consecutive Cours of Episodes

While two consecutive cours of episodes usually means that an anime will be running for at least 23-25 episodes before a season wraps, it could end up being much different for Devils’ Crest case. The anime did not premiere until this month, which makes it an entire month late compared to the rest of the ongoing Fall 2026 anime schedule . The usual Fall slate will be ending their respective runs towards the end of December, and each of them will be getting 12-13 episodes before hitting that point. But that’s probably not the case here.

Given Devils’ Crest’ s late start, it’s about four or so episodes behind. That means it likely might only have about 20 episodes or so when it wraps up its run next year. That’s also if it ends up having a full Winter 2027 cour either . But at the same time, it’s still guaranteeing that this new anime run won’t be slowing down until at least sometime early next year. There’s going to be quite a lot to break down over its debut season, and that’s plenty to be excited about.

What to Know for Devils’ Crest

If you wanted to check out Devils’ Crest as it airs its new episodes through the Fall 2026 and Winter 2027 seasons, you can now find it streaming exclusively with Prime Video worldwide . The first two episodes of the new series are available as of this time, and it features both Japanese and English language audio. The series is directed by Kenichiro Komaya for Production I.G. with Shinji Ushiro serving as chief director, Eiji Umehara providing the scripts, Yuki Hayashi composing the music, and original light novel artist Yukiko Horiguchi providing the character designs.

If you’re familiar with Reki Kawahara’s work on Sword Art Online , Devils’ Crest is going to seem even more familiar. After a group of middle school students agree to test out a new virtual reality game, they find themselves suddenly trapped within it. But this time around it’s almost as if the game world has blended into the real world, and has resulted in some bloody and brutal moments so far. But how are you liking Devils’ Crest so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Crunchyroll Streams Suikoden Anime
content:
The series began streaming with English subtitles on YouTube for free beginning on October 6 with new episodes on Tuesdays. The stream is available in North America, Latin America, the Caribbean, Ireland, parts of Africa and the Middle East, and in New Zealand and Australia. The staff have listed the full region availability on the anime's X/Twitter account in English.

Ani-One Asia has also licensed the anime.

The anime debuted on October 3 on Tokyo MX at 11:30 p.m. (10:30 a.m. EDT)

Konami describes Suikoden II :

Our story's hero and his friend Jowy are members of the Unicorn Youth Brigade, which participated in a drawn-out border dispute between the Highland Kingdom and the City-States of Jowstown. A few months earlier, a truth agreement was signed between the two forces, both of which were happy to see an end to the fighting. However, hidden under the momentary peace the fires of a new war continued to smolder

Previously announced cast members include:

• Toshiki Kumagai as Riliu

• Shimba Tsuchiya as Jowy

• Ayumi Hinohara as Nanami

• Katsuyuki Konishi as Viktor

• Yūichi Nakamura as Flik

• Taku Yashiro as Luca Blight

• Chika Anzai as Jillia Blight

• Akihiro Mine as Rowd

• Tsukino Chikasada as Pilika

• Ayumu Murase as Luc

• Takeo Ōtsuka as Shu

• Yoshino Aoyama as Apple

• Masato Niwa as Mukumuku

• Jun Kasama as Culgan

• Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Seed

• Megumi Han as Leknaat

• Shōta Hayama as Gengen

• Ryūnosuke Watanuki as Rikimaru

• Saya Hitomi as Rina

• Mizutama Umino as Eilie

• Yūsuke Sasaki as Bolgan

• Jin Yamanoi as Agares Blight

• Miyuki Sawashiro as Anabelle

• Kōdai Sakai as Jess

Yūzō Satō (credited as just YUZO on the anime's English website) is directing the anime at KONAMI animation , the game studio's anime studio. NBCUniversal Entertainment Japan anime and music production department member Ryō Hino serves as the producer and production manager.

Michihiro Tsuchiya ( PriPara , ClassicaLoid ) is overseeing the series scripts. Fumi Ishikawa from Konami Digital Entertainment is credited as the game character designer, Arata Suzuki from Konami Digital Entertainment is credited for the original drafts of the anime character designs, and Ryō Yamauchi ( My Master Has No Tail ; Please Put Them On, Takamine-san! ) is the anime character designer. Yoshikazu Iwanami ( Psycho-Pass , Ghost in the Shell Arise ) is the sound director, and Kōji Nakamura ( EUREKA SEVEN AO , Ping Pong live-action film) is composing the music.

Suikoden I&II HD Remaster Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars , the HD remastered release of Konami 's classic role-playing games Suikoden and Suikoden II , launched for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC via Steam in March 2025.

Konami released the original game for the PlayStation in 1995, followed by the sequel game in 1998. The series has five main installments and five spinoff games.

Konami is also developing the new mobile and PC game Gensō Suikoden : Star Leap , which launched for iOS and Android on August 7 in Japan. The game is also slated for PC via Steam . The developers assured players on August 7 the will have a release in English, French, German, Korean, and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).

title: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run Shows Off Its Stands With New Trailer – Watch
content:
JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run has been airing its new episodes through the Fall, and a special new trailer is showing off all of the cool new Stands that have made their debuts thus far. JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure first made its highly anticipated return for the seventh iteration of Hirohiko Araki’s original manga series earlier this Spring, but unfortunately sparked some outrage among fans for only returning for a single episode. But thankfully, most of that has passed with the debut of its second and third stages.

JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run is back in action this Fall with the 2nd and 3rd Stages of its episodes , and that means fans have gotten to see a lot more of what this next generation of the franchise has to offer. That naturally includes the many new Stands and their abilities that have made their debut over the episodes seen thus far, and a new trailer is helping to show off all of the wild new Stands. You can check it out in action below.

JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run Trailer Reveals New Stands

JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run 2nd & 3rd Stages are now streaming their episodes exclusively with Netflix worldwide , and new episodes are dropping on Fridays on a weekly basis for the Fall 2026 anime schedule. Picking up with the seventh iteration of Araki’s original manga series, it’s actually the best time to jump into the anime if you have never seen it in action before. Acting as a sort of clean break for the franchise following the events of Stone Ocean , it’s in its own continuity with an entirely new timeline and universe.

The final episodes of Stone Ocean had completely rewritten the universe, and Steel Ball Run throws fans into an entirely new continuity and setting as a result. Though Johnny Joestar shares a name with the protagonists from the first six entries, and features some characters who have similarities with the other iterations, this is still something brand new that fans who aren’t fully experienced with the anime’s past can jump into. But it’s not going to hold back from being wild as evidenced by the trailer seen in action here.

What to Know for JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run

JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run originally debuted a single episode earlier this Spring before returning for another batch of episodes this Fall, and that’s because the production behind this iteration of the anime has been some of the most intense yet. Steel Ball Run producer Noriko Dohi explained that this season in particular had been “difficult” to put together citing the fact that much of it is done on horses, and that does make a lot of sense considering that horses make up so much of this new iteration.

But given how fans have been responding to the episodes, new Stand abilities, and more thus far, it really has been a success for Steel Ball Run . This has been the iteration that fans had most wanted to see in action after first seeing it in the manga years ago, and thankfully all of that waiting has been paying off so far. title: Get Backers Teases Return With Mysterious 'Strongest Duo' Video, No New Anime Project Announced
content:
Get Backers appears to be preparing for a new revival project, with the franchise’s official YouTube channel confirming that it is behind the mysterious teaser recently shared on X.

The teaser was posted by the newly created @reclaim_00 account with the message, “The strongest duo moves again.” While the video itself avoids naming the series, the official Get Backers YouTube channel has linked directly to the post and asked fans to help spread it while avoiding references to the title or character names.

In its message to fans, the channel said it is currently working toward “restarting” the property and wants to build momentum around Get Backers again. It added that further details cannot yet be revealed.

The exact nature of the project remains unknown. No new TV anime, remake, sequel, manga project, or other format has been announced at this time. You can watch the teaser video below.

Original manga artist Rando Ayamine also acknowledged the development after initially saying he was unaware of rumors surrounding a Get Backers restart. Ayamine later said that he had been contacted and asked fans to wait for the official announcement.

The teaser follows recent activity on the official Get Backer s YouTube channel, which uploads a voiced comic anime using panels from the original manga. The channel recently resumed uploads after an extended break of over ten months. Its videos credit Yuya Aoki for the original story, Rando Ayamine for the artwork, and Frontier NEXT as publisher.

Get Backers , written by Yuya Aoki and illustrated by Rando Ayamine, was serialized in Weekly Shonen Magazine from 1999 to 2007. The story follows Ban and Ginji, a pair of retrieval specialists who take on jobs recovering stolen or lost items. The manga previously received a 49-episode TV anime by Studio Deen, which aired from 2002 to 2003. The official YouTube comic anime currently features Taro Sakamii as Ban and Takayuki Ito as Ginji, rather than the cast of the earlier TV adaptation (Nobutoshi Canna as Ban Mido and Shotaro Morikubo as Ginji Amano). Prime Video streams the anime, describing the story: Ban and Ginji are on a new case recovering a box for a high-paying client, on the condition that their payment is 1/10th of the contents of the box. Ban and Ginji have to retrieve it from a transport service, but they meet a very strong opponent.

title: Kodansha's Comic Tint Digital Magazine to End After 9 Years
content:
The 103rd issue of Kodansha 's Comic Tint digital manga magazine announced on Friday that the magazine will cease its run, with its last issue being the 105th issue debuting on January 1.

Manga in the magazine will move to Kodansha 's digial magazine Ane Friend and the Palcy manga app. The last two issues of the magazine will reveal more details.

Comic Tint launched its first issue on April 6, 2018 with the aim of publishing "sweet, stimulating romance manga incorporating female desires" not usually found in shōjo manga.

Some of the manga titles that ran in the magazine that received English releases include That Beauty Is a Tramp , This Vampire Won't Give Up! , Changes of Heart , A Serenade for Pretend Lovers , and Irresistible Mistakes .

title: DMM Establishes New Animation Studio Gleestone
content:
DMM.com announced on Tuesday that it has established GLEESTONE, a new animation studio which will handle animation works — including television series, movies, and shorts — from their initial planning stages to the actual animation production. Naokazu Tsuruta , the head of DMM Group's content creative unit, is the new company's president and CEO. Anime producer Kensuke Tateishi is the chief operating officer, and Kō Shimizu and Kōya Takami are the company's producers.

The company's name embodies its wishes to deliver the ultimate "Glee" that will make audiences' hearts race, and to preserve that emotion as if engraving it in "Stone."

The company's philosophy includes creating works that will linger in people's hearts even a decade from now, and creating works that resonate with people's hearts through countless eras rather than chasing trends.

DMM established the " DMM Pictures " animation label in March 2017. The label participates in the anime industry as a licensing company and as part of anime production committees. The company has been involved in the production of over 120 projects such as Fire Force , Inuyashiki Last Hero , Rent-A-Girlfriend , and Blue Period . DMM Pictures is also credited with the original planning of TROYCA 's original anime series Shinobi no Ittoki , which premiered in October 2022.

DMM established the CUE animation production in 2023, with former Production I.G executive board officer and production head Rui Kuroki as president and CEO. The company stated then that it aims to provide a higher quality of animation, in response to the growing popularity of anime worldwide.

title: Light Novel 'Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu' Concludes with 10th Volume
content:
The official X account for author Nana Mikoshiba announced on Tuesday that the Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu: Sekai Saikyou no Majutsushi de Aru Shounen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ni Nyuugaku suru ( The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ) light novel series will end with its tenth volume, scheduled to be released on December 2.

The main story has already concluded, with the final volume featuring revised and expanded side stories from the web novel, as well as an original story covering Ray White's college years.

Mikoshiba began writing the action fantasy light novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in October 2019. Kodansha began publishing the novel under its Ranobe Bunko imprint in July 2020, with illustrations by Riko Korie ( Juuou Mujin no Fafnir ). The ninth volume was published on June 2.

Norihito Sasaki serialized the manga adaptation in Magazine pocket from June 2020 to January 2024. Kodansha released the 16th volume in April 2024.

A sequel manga adaptation by Nao Kagami, titled Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu II began serialization on the Suiyoubi no Sirius web service on May 27.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in English in October 2021. The 13th volume went on sale on June 2.

Produced by Cloud Hearts , the first season aired as a 12-episode series in Winter 2023. The second season was produced by Zero-G and began airing on October 9. Crunchyroll simulcast both seasons with subtitles in multiple languages and an English dub.
